bagging: Train independent models on each training game, each from the same start. Geometric mean of multipliers, then shrink log-displacement toward the start: exp(log(start)+alpha*mean(log(trained/start))). Missing multiplier=1. Clamp 0.2..5.0. No selection using outer-test results.
selection: Within each outer fold, use only its two training games for inner leave-one-out. Require pooled error <= none for 5-15s and >=1 percentage point lower than none separately in each of 15-30,30-60,60-120s. Require equal sample counts and equal errBase to exclude changed coverage. Among eligible choose smallest 1:2:3 weighted mean of those long-bin errors; stable list-order tie break. If none eligible, choose none. Final recipe chosen by the same rule on all three cross-fitted inner results; final weights trained on all three only after all outer tests.
aggregation: Within each age bucket sum(n*errModel)/sum(n); also report equal-game macro averages. Percentage = Euclidean minimap distance / map side * 100, not a relative improvement percentage.
noise: Differences below 1 percentage point are noise for claims of superiority. No adaptive alteration of weights or candidates after seeing outer results.
interpretation: Candidate comparison alone is exploratory because selection across candidates reuses these three games. Nested row evaluates the selection procedure. Three games do not establish generalization or independence of frame-level samples.
expert_rationale: Hypotheses based on existing table: modest stay increase, slightly more early jungle farming, later ADC/support mid allocation, solo-laner side allocation. Do not strongly boost dragon/baron because goal_prior already multiplies by four when available/soon. No patch-specific assertion. Unknown role stays unchanged.
